title: Assistance for Vendors Displaced from Kreta Ayer Weekend Market and Their Return after Its Renovation
what_it_is: Assistance for Vendors Displaced from Kreta Ayer Weekend Market and Their Return after Its Renovation

sections.label: Kreta Ayer Flea Market operator
sections.summary: The Kreta Ayer Flea Market was organised and operated by the Kreta Ayer Community Centre Management Committee.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The Kreta Ayer Flea Market was organised and operated by the Kreta Ayer Community Centre Management Committee (KA CCMC).

sections.label: Flea market closure and NEA permits
sections.summary: KA CCMC told NEA the flea market would cease from 2 July 2018, offered vendors support, and NEA has received no new trade fair permit application.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In June this year, KA CCMC informed NEA that the flea market would be affected by construction works and would, therefore, cease operations from 2 July 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Prior to the market’s closure, we understand that KA CCMC, as the operator of the flea market, had reached out to individual vendors about a month ahead of the closure to explain the decision and address the vendors’ concerns.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: KA CCMC further offered financial support and referred some of them to temporary flea markets at other precincts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: NEA has not received any new application for a trade fair permit to restart the Kreta Ayer Flea Market.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: NEA will assess such applications on a case-by-case basis, taking into consideration the potential impact on fair competition for the surrounding shops and the need to minimise disamenities to residents in the vicinity.
